description: This source file defines a `Client` class for a stress testing client that interacts with a Kuksa (vehicle data) backend, handling different connection protocols ('ws' for WebSocket, 'grpc' for gRPC). It includes methods for initializing, connecting, and starting the client based on configuration.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Represents a client for stress testing Kuksa backend, capable of initiating connections based on protocol specified in configuration.

methods.name: start(self)
methods.description: Determines the protocol from configuration, initiates connection, and authorizes if using WebSocket.

methods.name: connect(self)
methods.description: Creates and starts a KuksaClientThread instance with the current configuration.

methods.name: __init__(self, file)
methods.description: Initializes the Client instance with configuration loaded from the specified file.
